name: Lip mask (overnight)
lead: An overnight lip mask is a thick, occlusive lip treatment left on during sleep, in the same category as lip balm and petroleum jelly, which form a barrier that slows moisture loss from the lips [1][2]. Overnight balms are described as using thicker emollients such as lanolin for longer moisture retention [3]. Wikipedia notes that medical-grade lanolin can speed healing of chapped lips [4].
No studies of products marketed as lip masks and no community sources were found.

paras: Petroleum jelly forms a barrier that slows moisture loss and can prevent chapped lips, and slugging, a related skincare practice, applies a thick layer before bed [2]. Contact allergy to lip-product ingredients such as beeswax and propolis has been reported [5].

refs.title: Contact allergy to beeswax and propolis among patients with cheilitis or facial dermatitis

card.summary: Thick overnight occlusive for lips; standard moisturizing care with no appearance trials.
card.note: Ingredient allergies such as beeswax or propolis are documented.

quick.overview:
An overnight lip mask is a heavy, occlusive lip product worn while sleeping. It works like thick lip balm.

No studies of lip masks specifically were found.
quick.mechanism: Occlusive ingredients such as petrolatum and lanolin slow water loss from the lips.
quick.risks: Allergic reactions to ingredients like beeswax and propolis have been reported.
